test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'. 

Austin can __be saw chasing__ cops with a sickle.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1: "Austin can be seen chasing cops with a sickle."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "be" should be changed to "be seen" to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• "Be seen" is the passive voice form of "see," which is the appropriate verb to use in this context.
 
• The use of "can" indicates that it is possible to see Austin chasing cops with a sickle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sentence implies that Austin is engaging in a dangerous or illegal activity.
 
• The use of a sickle as a weapon adds to the sense of danger and violence in the sentence."
